entries.speaker: Girl in Blue
entries.en: My name... is Lavenza.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I was torn apart by a malevolent will[n]and took the form of those twins.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I sought help before my body was split[n]in two.
A malevolent will?
Help?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: If we lose you, the path to the Holy Grail[n]will forever be closed.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: That's why you must recall the truth[n]once more.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: And I beg of you... Please save us!

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: ...I believed in you. I knew that you would[n]make it thus far.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: And to the scoundrel who has swindled[n]my master's name...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Your lies shall work no longer now that[n]my sight has been restored!

entries.speaker: Igor?
entries.en: The game isn't over yet.

entries.speaker: Igor?
entries.en: Whether the human world is left as is or[n]destroyed and rebuilt, it is all sport to me.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Be careful.
What are you?
If you're not Igor, then...

entries.speaker: Igor?
entries.en: If I were to put it into words that you can[n]comprehend, I am the Holy Grail that[n]grants wishes...

entries.speaker: Igor?
entries.en: No... It may be more accurate to say that[n]I am a god who responds to desire and[n]holds dominion over man.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: I hoped seeing a righteous thief vanquish[n]evil would spur mankind to change their[n]own indolent hearts.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: However... the result is as you know—[n]the masses have made it so none of it[n]has transpired.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: Humans should be met with ruin:[n]you brought forth that answer.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: But to be frank, Inmate, I believe it may[n]be worth reevaluating you.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: A human has reached the Holy Grail[n]and has seen through my true identity...

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: You've surprised the god that I am[n]often enough. That cannot be done[n]by a foolish commoner.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: You truly were a prisoner that did not[n]bore me.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: Perhaps observing you a while longer[n]may prove amusing.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: I shall grant you an opportunity to make[n]a deal with me.
What is this deal?
What do you mean?

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: Should you wish it, I shall return the[n]world to its prior state—one rampant[n]with distorted masses.
Revert the world? Could[n]it be telling the truth...?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You forcefully dragged him into the[n]Metaverse and imposed an ordeal[n]he did not deserve...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Yet you still intend on toying with him!?

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves will be praised[n]and gain fame. The world will escape[n]ruin as well.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: ...What say you?
If I agree to this, the ruined city will[n]return to normal.
However, the people will remain trapped,[n]abandoning their ability to think for[n]themselves...
Is that really how the world should be?
I refuse.
Very well...

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: *chuckle* Our contract has been sealed[n]then.
It's a good deal.
Actually... never mind.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: ...A pact between a false god and[n]a human we placed our hopes on.[n]Even we could not have predicted this.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You have even undone my master's wish...[n]You are a Trickster after all...

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: *chuckle* You truly are a child of man...[n]It seems you couldn't win against your[n]own desires.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: There is no need to be ashamed. I shall[n]grant you that wish...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Well said.

entries.speaker: God of Control
entries.en: Such irredeemable foolishness... You[n]choose death for yourself? Very well.[n]I have no need for you.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Master!

entries.speaker: Bizarre Old Man
entries.en: Mmgh...

entries.speaker: Bizarre Old Man
entries.en: Oh my... It's been quite a while since[n]I last stepped foot in this place...

entries.speaker: Bizarre Old Man
entries.en: Welcome to the Velvet Room.

entries.speaker: Bizarre Old Man
entries.en: My name is Igor. I am pleased to make[n]your acquaintance.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: He is the rightful master of this Velvet[n]Room, the true aid on your journey.
True aid?
I'm so lost.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It may be difficult for you to understand[n]this all at once.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: If I were to summarize this, the "fake"[n]has left, and the "real" has returned.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Indeed...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: My master has returned, and you won[n]against that malevolent god's temptation.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Thus, you may be able to save this world[n]that is headed toward certain ruin.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, it will prove difficult to win[n]against him with your power alone...
I know.
What should I do?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You must release your teammates, with[n]whom you've shared your conviction.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This place exists between dream and[n]reality, mind and matter...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: They have not necessarily expired yet.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Just as you were trapped here, they[n]should be confined somewhere as well...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Since you've deepened your bond with[n]them, I am certain you can release them.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Once they—the Phantom Thieves—are all[n]gathered here...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: We will tell you everything.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Now, go forth—to the people whom[n]you should be facing the truth with!
